name: Snow Trail
description: Inside its area the pointer sheds a short trail of tiny flakes that fall, drift and fade, and a click throws a small flurry.

props.name: rate
props.description: How many flakes are shed per distance moved. Faster movement sheds more on top of this. 0 turns the trail and the click flurry off.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the flakes. The default is a cool blue-grey shade under a white body by day and near-white with a faint glow at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the area. The flakes are drawn above it and never take the pointer, so links, buttons and text selection work as usual.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and sets the size of the area. Other div props are passed through.
